content:
maria_csm: Post-onboard smoke check for HarborStrand private deployment. Two items flagged by QA: (1) audit log delivery to our ingest shows no recent entries, (2) their KMS key still has broad group binding from initial testing. Can we triage? cc @alex_infra @sam_security @devon_eng

alex_infra: On it. Do we know if they used host-project or shared-VPC? That changes which peering rules to check.

devon_eng: They used host-project topology. I can confirm routes in their project but our collector isn't seeing packets. Might be firewall or missing route import.

alex_infra: I'll pull BGP status and route import/export rules. If import/export isn't set the routes won't propagate into our collector network.

sre_bot: incident: audit-forwarder/harborstrand-forwarder failing 503 x3 checks. last log: `POST /ingest -> 503 upstream` (04:36 UTC).

devon_eng: Quick check: their route shows up as `route-0-0-0-0` pointing at ilb-harbor-01, but collector FW has deny for 10.40.0.0/16.

alex_infra: Hmm. If collector FW blocks that CIDR, forwarder connections will never arrive. I can open a temporary allow rule for smoke: `gcloud compute firewall-rules create tmp-allow-harbor --network=collector-net --allow=tcp:9000 --source-ranges=10.40.0.0/16 --priority=65534` then revert. Will do once Devon confirms.
devon_eng: I can restart the forwarder after the rule is applied. Will tail logs and paste results here.
sam_security: KMS note: their key policy lists `group:harbor-devs@newco.com` with roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter. We requested SA-only bindings. Recommend replacing group principal with `serviceAccount:harbor-audit@newco.iam.gserviceaccount.com` and enable key rotation on a 90-day schedule. Also enable CMEK on the logging sink. I'll draft an example gcloud command and a policy diff.
maria_csm: Good. Action items: (1) @alex_infra verify BGP/routes and open temp firewall for smoke, (2) @devon_eng restart forwarder and confirm logs appear in our ingest, (3) @sam_security push KMS binding PR and rotation plan to the customer. If unresolved in 14 days mark renewal risk flag due to compliance gap. I'll assemble a short handoff doc for HarborStrand with steps, who to contact, and rollback notes.
devon_eng: Restarted forwarder after firewall rule created. Logs show a few POSTs, then `200 OK` responses. Pasted tail: `2026-03-21T04:42:10Z forwarder: sent batch 1 -> 200`, `2026-03-21T04:42:12Z forwarder: ack batch 1`
sre_bot: info: ingest/harbor-collector accepted batches from 10.40.5.12 (04:42 UTC).
alex_infra: Verified BGP: sessions established, route import/export looks correct now (they had missing import before we suggested changes). I removed temp firewall after confirming healthy ingest.
sam_security: Policy PR posted: changes include removing `group:harbor-devs@newco.com` and binding only the `harbor-audit` SA, adding `kmsKeyRings.get` where needed, and enabling rotation schedule. Leaving comments for customer to approve.
maria_csm: Excellent. Closing loop: smoke succeeded, audit logs flowing, KMS PR pending customer approval. I will notate this as "onboarded with follow-up" and keep renewal score steady but note that KMS approval is required for full compliance. Will follow up next week. :white_check_mark:
